subject.title: fix(ios): connect iPhone and Watch to protocol v3 gateways

question: Should this PR require live iPhone-to-protocol-v3 Gateway proof, including the paired-Watch relay path claimed in the PR, or should maintainers explicitly override that proof gate based on the protocol contract and tests?
rationale: Static contract checks strongly support the implementation, but only a maintainer can accept the compatibility risk without the repository-required real native setup proof.

options.title: Require live Apple proof
options.body: Request redacted logs, terminal output, or a recording showing an iPhone node connecting to a protocol-v3 Gateway and exercising a representative node operation, plus paired-Watch relay proof if that claim remains.

options.title: Grant proof override
options.body: Explicitly accept the contract and test evidence as sufficient for this internal-preview native surface and record a proof override before merge.

recommendation.title: Require live Apple proof
recommendation.body: Request redacted logs, terminal output, or a recording showing an iPhone node connecting to a protocol-v3 Gateway and exercising a representative node operation, plus paired-Watch relay proof if that claim remains.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is self-assigned and the available repository history connects this person most directly to the affected iOS, Watch, and Gateway surfaces.
